nodes.label: AppHeader.svelte
nodes.summary: Header component with animated tab navigation (Overview/Analyze) and bubble indicator. Uses Svelte event dispatching, keyboard Tab support for switching, and responsive CSS layout.

nodes.label: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file that re-exports all constant modules from src/lib/constants/.

nodes.label: boosts.ts
nodes.summary: Boost/perk damage multiplier constants including Frenzy, Minion, Venom Eater, Lifesteal, Holy Infusion, Bellowing Ember, and ~40 per-stack multipliers for perks like Blood Thirsty, Venom Spitter, Perfection, Golden Crits, etc.

nodes.label: buffs.ts
nodes.summary: Buff/debuff potency and duration constants for potions, rune-granted buffs, basic debuffs, weapon art buffs, True Balance conversions, PERK_BUFFS factory values, and BUFF_POTENCY_MODIFIERS.

nodes.label: cdr.ts
nodes.summary: Cooldown reduction constants for perks and weapon arts: Caster, Channeled Weapon, Mage Rage, Poison Accel, Runic Winds, Wave Rider, Whirlwind, Gladiatorial Set, and Voltaic Body.

nodes.label: damage-types.ts
nodes.summary: Damage type metadata (labels, colors), defense inheritance tree, type priority for tie-breaking, and tracked type sets for the damage calculation engine.

nodes.label: debuff-effects.ts
nodes.summary: Debuff combat effect multipliers: Sticky damage mult, Despair display divisor/mult/damage coefficient.

nodes.label: defensive.ts
nodes.summary: Defensive perk damage reduction constants: Barb Skin, Stone Skin, Adaptive Plate, Protector Spirit, Air Pressure, Valor, Vampire, Frenzy, Stored Corruption, Mounted Defense, Carapace, Cursed Bark.

nodes.label: dot-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Damage-over-time constants: base damage, infliction divisor, potency cap, rounding factor, and builder-to-game conversion rate.

nodes.label: draconic-colors.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic color-specific combat multipliers for Fire, Air, Earth, Water, and Hex draconic colors (speed, damage, knockback, cooldown, stun).

nodes.label: draconic.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic infusion and Dragon State constants: potency/duration multipliers, HP thresholds, base damage, per-stack scaling, and Bastion Bless multiplier.

nodes.label: game.ts
nodes.summary: Core game constants: max/default level, base HP calculation with level scaling, HP fill defaults, and timing constants for save debounce, undo window, and UI delays.

nodes.label: heals.ts
nodes.summary: Healing-related constants: crit healing base and per-stack values, holy boost divisor, and Ocean Song per-stack multiplier.

nodes.label: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central barrel file aggregating and re-exporting all constants sub-modules (damage-types, game, storage, thresholds, perks, boosts, heals, draconic, perk-base-damage, rune-base-damage, buffs, stat-conversions, defensive, dot-damage, draconic-colors, cdr, debuff-effects, wa-display).

nodes.label: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Perk base damage values for ~30 perks including Dragon Claw, Springblast, spirit summons, Bounce Momentum, Air Pressure, Roaring Heads, Barbed Flurry, Volatile Shell, Dark Harvest, Pyre Bloom, Bastion Ballista, Runic Blades, and more.

nodes.label: perks.ts
nodes.summary: Perk-related combat constants: crit base values, crit-rate/ crit-damage multipliers, elemental crit conversions, Mortal Will, Sunburn, Frostbite, Cryo Engine, Fiery Pursuit, Hypnotist, Phantom Pain, and Pursuit.

nodes.label: rune-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Rune base damage values for Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, Thunderous Charge, Sporeling Toss, Foot Dive, Caci, Cacitrops, Hex Web, Brainblast, and Rocky Tail.

nodes.label: stat-conversions.ts
nodes.summary: Stat boost conversion rates for weight distribution, Quick Witted, Whirl Foot, Carapace, Extra Layers, Frozen Heart, Immovable, Righted Wrongs, Rocky Body, Spellshield, Strong Tides, Swift Guard, True Balance, Rawnwy, and subtraction modifiers.

nodes.label: storage.ts
nodes.summary: LocalStorage key constants, build state defaults (empty/initial build), save key mappings for compression, enchantment slot mappings, and build slot limits.

nodes.label: thresholds.ts
nodes.summary: Game mechanic threshold constants: armor pen branch threshold, cooldown minimum, and base crit damage percentage.

nodes.label: wa-display.ts
nodes.summary: Weapon Art display name mappings and getWADisplayName function for resolving WA names based on equipped perks.

nodes.label: crit.ts
nodes.summary: Critical hit calculation engine: combines natural, elemental, and extra crit sources with proc coefficient scaling, Primal divisor handling, and comprehensive crit damage multiplier breakdown.

nodes.label: damageTypeResolve.ts
nodes.summary: Damage type resolution utilities: resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions, applies Fire-Air conversion (Echo Incineration), Air-to-Magic conversion (Spirit Winds), and merges base types with bonuses.

nodes.label: defense.ts
nodes.summary: Defense calculation engine: resolves percent and flat defense sources, computes effective multipliers, and maps damage types to their defense stat keys via DEF_GROUP.

nodes.label: dmgTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Damage type type definitions and badge configuration: BADGE_CONFIG for in-game effect badges, ComputedType, PerkOnHitDmg, and ComputedHit interfaces for the damage computation pipeline.

nodes.label: calcBaseMaxHP
nodes.summary: Calculates base max HP: round(120 * (1 + level * 0.0125)).

nodes.label: getWADisplayName
nodes.summary: Resolves the display name for a weapon art given its base name and equipped perks, checking the WA_PERK_DISPLAY_NAMES mapping.

nodes.label: DMG_TYPE_META
nodes.summary: Record mapping each damage type key to its display label and color.

nodes.label: DEF_TRACKED_TYPES
nodes.summary: Tuple of damage types that track defense: physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy.

nodes.label: DEF_INHERITANCE
nodes.summary: Maps sub-types to their parent defense type (air/physical, earth/physical, fire/water, water/magic, hex/magic, holy/magic).

nodes.label: DMG_TYPE_PRIORITY
nodes.summary: Damage type priority order for tie-breaking when resolving 'Highest damage type'.

nodes.label: ALL_DMG_TYPES
nodes.summary: All 10 damage types: physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true, summon.

nodes.label: TRACKED_TYPES_WITH_TRUE
nodes.summary: Tracked types including true damage: physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true.

nodes.label: BUILD_STATE_DEFAULTS
nodes.summary: Default build state object with empty strings, zero upgrades, default level/HP, and false toggles.

nodes.label: SAVE_KEY_MAP
nodes.summary: Maps full build property names to short compression keys for URL/save sharing.

nodes.label: CritResult
nodes.summary: Comprehensive crit calculation result with natural/extra crit chances, crit damage multiplier, breakdowns, Primal handling, proc coefficient scaling info, and formula string.

nodes.label: calcCrit
nodes.summary: Main crit calculation function taking stats, perks, and optional hit proc coefficient. Returns CritResult with all breakdowns, Primal divisor logic, and proc-coefficient-aware scaling.

nodes.label: resolveDamageTypes
nodes.summary: Merges base damage types with bonus damage types, summing values for matching keys.

nodes.label: applyFireAirConversion
nodes.summary: Converts 50% of Fire to Air and 50% of Air to Fire (Echo Incineration mechanic).

nodes.label: resolveWaDamageTypeKeys
nodes.summary: Parses WA damage type string (e.g. 'Same as weapon', 'Highest damage type', or explicit type distribution) into a Record<type, amount>.

nodes.label: getFinalWaDmgTypes
nodes.summary: Computes final WA damage types by resolving base types then merging with bonuses.

nodes.label: applyAirToMagicConversion
nodes.summary: Converts a fraction of Air damage to Magic (Spirit Winds), applies Echo Incineration, then adds Dark Magic hex conversion on native magic only.

nodes.label: DefenseSource
nodes.summary: Raw defense source with name, defPct, optional isFlat flag and condition string.

nodes.label: DefenseBreakdown
nodes.summary: Complete defense calculation result with percent/flat sources, their multipliers, and final combined multiplier.

nodes.label: resolveDefenseSources
nodes.summary: Resolves an array of DefenseSource into a DefenseBreakdown, computing percent/flat multipliers via calcDefMultiplier and calcTrueDrPercent.

nodes.label: DEF_GROUP
nodes.summary: Maps each damage type to its relevant defense stat keys (e.g. physical -> ['physicalDefense'], air -> ['airDefense', 'physicalDefense']).

nodes.label: calcBaseArmorDefPct
nodes.summary: Looks up defense stat keys for a damage type via DEF_GROUP and sums the stat values.

nodes.label: BADGE_CONFIG
nodes.summary: Configuration for in-game effect badges with color, label, and title/description for ~26 effects (Dragon State, Spore Burst, Chain, Luminescent, etc.).

nodes.label: ComputedType
nodes.summary: Computed damage type with key, label, color, base/scaling/combat multipliers, boosts, defense mult, raw/crit values, and hit metadata.

nodes.label: PerkOnHitDmg
nodes.summary: On-hit perk damage configuration with base damage, scaling, combat multipliers, damage types, proc coefficient, and hit behavior flags.

nodes.label: ComputedHit
nodes.summary: Represents a single computed hit with group, index, finisher status, damage types, proc coefficient, and hit count.
